fixes.action: Require two-factor authentication for the organization, after notifying the 3 members and 2 outside collaborators without it; outside collaborators who have not enabled it are removed.
fixes.effort: An hour, after a week's notice

fixes.action: Register passkeys or security keys for both owners and remove any SMS method; keep TOTP only as a backup.
Set base permissions for members to None and grant repository access through teams.
Turn off repository creation for members, so only owners create repositories.
Remove the former vendor's staff member from client-portal, then review outside collaborators' access every quarter and record each review.
Set up OAuth app access restrictions and approve only the OAuth apps the firm uses.
Require owner approval for fine-grained personal access tokens.
Set the organization's default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions to read-only, and grant write per workflow where a job needs it.
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for the owners' tenant accounts: require the phishing-resistant authentication strength for the highly privileged roles in Conditional Access.
